name: misfire
description: Misconception diagnoser for tutoring and education. When a student gives a wrong answer, reverse-engineers the broken mental model behind it, names the exact misconception, and returns a verified remediation move (contrast case + probe question). Uses Groq llama-3.3-70b with JSON-mode + a self-verification pass. Offline proof mode when no LLM key is present.

config.description: Groq API key for llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Falls back to provider.groq in ~/.synaps-cli/config, then to MISFIRE_LLM_KEY env. Offline proof mode is used when no key is available.
